title.value: Optimising Electric Vehicle Charging Station Placement using Advanced Discrete Choice Models
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the paper's focus on optimizing the placement of EV charging stations.
title.quote: Optimising Electric Vehicle Charging Station Placement using Advanced Discrete Choice Models

extractions.description: This paper presents a model for optimising the placement of electric vehicle charging stations to maximise EV adoption, considering user preferences and incorporating advanced discrete choice models.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on promoting the adoption of electric vehicles, which is directly related to reducing CO2 emissions and promoting sustainable transportation.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In order to meet CO 2 emissions goals, major changes at the global level are necessary. This includes the transportation sector... One initiative that has been proposed to reduce these emissions is the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), rather than internal combustion engine vehicles (ICEVs).

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is to reduce CO2 emissions in the transportation sector by promoting the adoption of electric vehicles.
primary_category.quote: One initiative that has been proposed to reduce these emissions is the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), rather than internal combustion engine vehicles (ICEVs).

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper directly addresses the transportation sector by optimising the placement of EV charging stations.
primary_sub_category.quote: This includes the transportation sector, which in 2019 was responsible for 27% of global CO 2 emissions

applications.justification: The paper aims to find the optimal placement of charging stations, which directly relates to optimizing individual EV charging.
applications.quote: The problem we examine is that of the decision makers responsible for public charging infrastructure, and the optimal placement of that infrastructure within a city.

new_primary_category.justification: There is no need for a new category.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no need for a new subcategory.
